item.coloph: khyad par 'phag ('phags) pa dran pa bdud 'dul bka'/ yangs (yongs) su dag pa bder gshegs rgyal ba'i lung / dngos grub mchog ldan mkha' 'gro snying gis (gi) nor/ 'di 'dra bon mchog klu chen yid bzhin nor/ man ngag zab pa'i yang zab rin chen nor/ ma 'ong ('ongs) dus mtha' kho'o 'phag (kho bo 'phags)btsun bdag mi 'gyur g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes/ gsang ba'i mtshan mchog pad ma g.yung drung thobs (thob/)sngon sbyang las zad g.yung drung sa la gnas/ ma 'ong ('ongs) don du bstan pa spel phyir dang / 'og min rgyal mtshan rtse la smon lam thobs/ 'dzam gling dbus su skyon bral pad ma 'khrung*/ las 'phro yang dag g.yung drung bon sgor zhugs/ las dang skal pa du ma bsags pa'i smon lam mtha'/ bcu gnyis lo len (lon) mdzod nag lhun grub khrod/ me pho sprel lo lug zla tshes gcig la/ sum cu gnas ni dkar mo mdangs ldan yis/ phyag g.yas dar dkar g.yug cing snyen (snyan) du brgyud/ rang sems mi dmigs stong pa'i mdzod la sbas/ nyi shu lo lon me res bkra shis khrod/ shing 'brug bya zla dus tshod yar ngo tshes/ bden bzhi mdzod gling slobs (gleng slob) dpon rin po che/ 'bru btsun dam pa g.yung drung ye shes dang / las ldan bon gshen rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ yul sa tshunas 'tshogs (phun tshogs) wa dag bkra shis thang*/ rgon (dgon) la phun 'tshogs (tshogs)bkra shis rtse kyis (yi) phug ri bo phun 'tshogs tshogs) brag dmar dpung pa'i bdag grog (grogs) la phun 'tshogs (tshogs) yul lha dkar po'i mdun/ dben la phun 'tshogs (tshogs) me ri bkra shis gnas/ gshen la phun 'tshogs (tshogs) rig 'dzin chen po yis/ 'khor la phun 'tshogs (tshogs) las ldan skyes bu 'khor/ bka' la phun 'tshogs (tshogs) rig 'dzinagsum kyis (gyi) bon/ dus la phun 'tshogs (tshogs) yar ngo tshes bzang la/ rgyud (rgyu) rkyen phun sum 'tshogs (tshogs) pa'i yi ge btab/ nyes dang 'gal ba ci mchis thams cad rnams/ rgyud srungs (srung) bka'i ma sring rnams la bshag (bshags/)lha srungs (srung) mkha' 'gros bka' chad ma mdzad la/ mthas yas 'gro rnams kun mkhyen sa thob shog/
